_readme: Explicitly RATIFIED per-state camera counts. When build-cameras.yml's >30% drop guard fires, camera-publish-guard.py publishes anyway IFF the new count is within +/-10% of the ratified count here. Ratify a REAL upstream drop by adding an entry via PR; a ratification older than 180 days warns. This breaks the deadlock where blocking a publish freezes the released baseline forever.

wyoming.reason: Upstream OSM removal of a bulk ALPR import; count stable 138-144 across 14 daily runs 2026-08-20..09-02; no tiles-repo change since 2026-07-03. Prior released baseline 546 was frozen by the publish-block deadlock.
